intro.heading: Get sense of your financial data
intro.description: Effortlessly track your transactions and gain powerful insights into your financial data. See where your money goes, visualize trends, and take control of your financial future—all in one intuitive platform.

feature1.heading: Comprehensive Transaction Tracking
feature1.description: Automatically sync your accounts or input transactions manually. Stay on top of your expenses, income, and financial habits with real-time updates.

feature2.heading: Visualize Your Data
feature2.description: Interactive charts and graphs make it easy to understand your spending patterns, compare categories, and identify areas for improvement.

feature3.heading: Financial Insights Made Easy
feature3.description: Receive automatic summaries and actionable tips based on your financial data to help you save more and spend smarter.

feature4.heading: Customizable and Secure
feature4.description: Tailor the platform to fit your unique financial goals. Your data is encrypted and privacy is our top priority.

section1.content3: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information. By using our service, you agree to the practices outlined in this policy.

section2.title: 1. Information We Collect
section2.note: We collect different types of information to provide and improve our services. This includes:

content.accountInformation: Account Information: Name, email address, password, etc.
content.transactionData: Transaction Data: Amounts, categories, accounts, descriptions, etc.
content.csvData: CSV Data: Uploaded files containing transaction data.
content.contactInformation: Contact Information: Email and other details provided through support inquiries.

content.usageData: Usage Data: Information about interactions with the platform.
content.deviceInformation: Device Information: IP address, browser type, operating system, etc.
content.cookiesAndTrackingTechnologies: Cookies and Tracking Technologies: Tools to enhance the user experience.

content.bankingIntegration: Banking Integration: Transaction data from linked accounts.
content.analyticsTools: Analytics Tools: Aggregated usage data from platforms like Google Analytics.

content.use1: To provide services such as tracking and visualizing financial data.
content.use2: To personalize your experience with tailored content and suggestions.
content.use3: To improve our platform based on usage patterns and feedback.
content.use4: To communicate with you about updates, notifications, and support.
content.use5: To ensure security and prevent fraudulent activities.
content.use6: To comply with legal obligations and regulations.

section4.title: 3. How We Share Your Information
section4.note: We do not sell your personal information. However, we may share your data under specific circumstances:

content.sharing1: For essential services like hosting and payment processing.
content.sharing2: To comply with laws, regulations, or legal processes.
content.sharing3: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets.
content.sharing4: For any other purpose not covered by this policy.

section5.title: 4. Data Security
section5.content: We implement industry-standard security measures, including encryption, access controls, and regular monitoring.

section6.title: 5. Your Rights and Choices
section6.note: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

subsection1.title: 5.1. Access and Update
subsection1.content: You can access and update your personal information through your account settings.

subsection2.title: 5.2. Data Portability
subsection2.content: You can request a copy of your data in a portable format.

subsection3.title: 5.3. Deletion
subsection3.content: You can request the deletion of your account and associated data. Note that some information may be retained for legal or operational purposes.

subsection4.title: 5.4. Opt-Out
subsection4.content: You can opt-out of marketing communications by clicking the 'unsubscribe' link in our emails.

subsection5.title: 5.5. Cookies
subsection5.content: Manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or our cookie management tool.

section7.title: 6. Data Retention
section7.content: We retain your data for as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. When data is no longer needed, we securely delete it.

content.note: You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may limit the functionality of the platform.

section9.title: 8. International Users
section9.content: Our service operates globally. By using our platform, you consent to the transfer and processing of your information in countries that may not have the same data protection laws as your country of residence.

section1.content3: By using our service, you agree to the terms and conditions outlined below. Please read these terms carefully before accessing or using our platform.

section2.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section2.content: By creating an account or using our services, you confirm that you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the service immediately.

section3.title: 2. Changes to Terms
section3.content: We reserve the right to update or modify these terms at any time. Significant changes will be notified to users, and your continued use of the platform after modifications implies acceptance of the updated terms.

content.responsibility1: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
content.responsibility2: You agree to use the service only for lawful purposes.
content.responsibility3: You must not attempt to disrupt or damage the service or its infrastructure.

section5.title: 4. Prohibited Activities
section5.note: The following activities are strictly prohibited:

content.prohibition1: Using the platform for fraudulent or illegal purposes.
content.prohibition2: Reverse engineering or attempting to access the service's source code.
content.prohibition3: Uploading harmful or malicious content to the platform.

section6.title: 5. Intellectual Property
section6.content: All intellectual property rights, including trademarks, logos, and service content, are owned by Finance Platform. You may not use, reproduce, or distribute these materials without prior written consent.

section7.title: 6. Termination
section7.content: We reserve the right to terminate your access to the service if you violate these terms or engage in prohibited activities. Upon termination, you must cease using the platform and delete any materials obtained through it.

section8.title: 7. Disclaimer of Warranties
section8.content: The service is provided 'as is' and 'as available.' We disclaim all warranties, including implied warranties of merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service.

section9.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
section9.content: Finance Platform is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the platform, even if we were advised of such possibilities.
